items.question: Which vaccinations does Saudi Arabia require for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims coming from outside the Kingdom?
items.gold: Neisseria meningitis, yellow fever, polio, COVID-19 and seasonal influenza.
items.fact: Saudi Hajj mandates five vaccines for pilgrims from abroad

items.question: For Saudi Arabia Hajj and Umrah pilgrims coming from inside the Kingdom, within how many years must the meningitis vaccine have been given?
items.gold: The meningitis vaccine must have been given in the past five years.
items.fact: Domestic pilgrims' meningitis vaccine must be within past five years
